question: Which ritual actions follow the opening of the image’s eyes in the consecration sequence?
premises: The eye-opening rite is performed first.
inference: After performing the eye-opening, one should carry out image purification and circumambulation.
uncertainties: dṛśāmunmokṣaṇaṃ is a compact form possibly for netronmīlana/unmokṣaṇa
plain_english: Having performed the opening of the eyes, one should do the purification of the image and circumambulation.
